glance.label: Glance
glance.description: A quick look to one side and back, as if noticing something.

tilt-left.label: Tilt head left
tilt-left.description: A curious or playful head tilt toward the left of the screen.

tilt-right.label: Tilt head right
tilt-right.description: A curious or playful head tilt toward the right of the screen.

shrug-left.label: Shrug left
shrug-left.description: A small one-shoulder shrug on the left of the screen, for a casual maybe.

shrug-right.label: Shrug right
shrug-right.description: A small one-shoulder shrug on the right of the screen, for a casual maybe.

shrug-both.label: Shrug both
shrug-both.description: Both shoulders up, for not knowing or an easy-going who knows.

sigh.label: Sigh
sigh.description: A slow breath in and a sighing breath out, for weariness or relief.

stretch-yawn.label: Stretch & yawn
stretch-yawn.description: A long stretch with a yawn, for tiredness.

nod.label: Dozing nod
nod.description: The head dips as she dozes, then lifts.

wink-left.label: Wink left
wink-left.description: A wink with the eye on the left of the screen, for teasing or a shared secret.

wink-right.label: Wink right
wink-right.description: A wink with the eye on the right of the screen, for teasing or a shared secret.

look-around.label: Look around
look-around.description: Her eyes and head look one way, then the other, as if checking the room.

shiver.label: Little shiver
shiver.description: A quick shiver, for cold or a spooky thought.

nodding-off.label: Nodding off
nodding-off.description: The head sinks slowly as she falls asleep.

humming-bob.label: Humming bob
humming-bob.description: A gentle bob and sway, as if humming a tune.

contented-smile.label: Contented smile
contented-smile.description: A soft closed-mouth smile with relaxed eyes.

eyebrow-raise.label: Eyebrow raise
eyebrow-raise.description: Raised brows, for interest, a pointed remark or mild surprise.

deep-breath.label: Deep breath
deep-breath.description: A slow, deep breath, for calming down or getting ready.

neck-roll.label: Neck roll
neck-roll.description: A slow roll of the neck to loosen up.

weight-shift.label: Weight shift
weight-shift.description: She shifts her weight from one side to the other, a relaxed settle.

shy-look-away.label: Shy look-away
shy-look-away.description: A bashful glance down and away, for shyness or being flattered.

tentacle-wave.label: Tentacle wave
tentacle-wave.description: Ten seconds of her tentacles' full wave.

tentacle-perk.label: Tentacle perk
tentacle-perk.description: Her tentacles perk up, for excitement or good news.

tentacle-droop.label: Tentacle droop
tentacle-droop.description: Her tentacles droop for a few seconds, for disappointment or sadness.

tentacle-sway.label: Tentacle sway
tentacle-sway.description: Eight seconds of a gentle tentacle sway.
